tip.title: Quick start
tip.body: Pick a syndrome on the left and answer the questions; the recommendation updates at once. Search also finds synonyms and drug names. Your answers are remembered when you come back to a syndrome.

summary.printTip: Opens the summary as a print page in your browser; print it or save it as PDF (Ctrl+P)
